sections.title: Sound of A
paragraphs: You say the letter (A) /ə/ to name this sign. Its main sound appears in (apple) /æ.pəl/, which means a round fruit with red or green skin. The letter makes four different sounds in English words. Learn each sound through clear example words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, open your mouth wide. Drop your jaw low and keep your tongue flat at the front. For the second sound, glide from a mid vowel to a close vowel. Spread your lips slightly. For the third sound, relax your whole mouth and tongue. For the fourth sound, drop your jaw deep. Place your hand on your throat to feel your voice shake on all four sounds.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In a closed syllable, the letter makes its first sound, as in (cat) /kæt/. In an open stressed syllable or before silent final e, it sounds like (lake) /leɪk/. In an unstressed syllable, it becomes a short weak vowel, as in (about) /ə.baʊt/. Before certain consonants like lm or th, it sounds open and deep, as in (father) /fɑː.ðər/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace the sound in (cat) /kæt/ with the sound in (father) /fɑː.ðər/. Drop your jaw wide and keep your tongue front and flat. Do not say the glide in (lake) /leɪk/ as a single flat vowel. Move your tongue smoothly from the first sound to the second.
